decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until further details regarding the operation of the swipe system is provided to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that, subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposal would improve accessibility in respect of the Mental Health Unit and would increase security, whilst not having a harmful impact upon the appearance of the building. The proposal is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities) and C.3.2 (New or extended health facilities) within the LBH Unitary Development Plan (2003), and the Council's Think Access Guidelines 2000. Approval is therefore recommended.
description: Erection of a single storey front extension to main entrance incorporating internal alterations to Lakeside Mental Health Unit.
